The four XYZ files list every atom of four model zinc-blende CdSe nanocrystals (no ligands; angstrom). Use the empirical CdSe sizing curve of Yu et al. (Chem. Mater. 2003): D = 1.6122e-9·λ⁴ − 2.6575e-6·λ³ + 1.6242e-3·λ² − 0.4277·λ + 41.57, with D the particle diameter in nm and λ the wavelength of the first excitonic absorption peak in nm (valid for 400–700 nm), and its extinction law ε = 5857·D^2.65 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹ at that peak. Take D as the largest distance between any two atoms of the supplied nanocrystal. Model conditions: each nanocrystal is an ideal spherical cut from bulk zinc-blende CdSe (assumed lattice constant 6.08 Å) without ligands, surface relaxation or shape anisotropy; the empirical curves above were calibrated by Yu et al. on real nanocrystals whose sizes were measured by TEM, and are applied here to these ideal particles. You must choose one nanocrystal for a device such that it is the smallest particle whose first excitonic absorption peak lies at or beyond 565 nm. Which file should you choose?

选项：
A. CdSe-QD-D.xyz
B. CdSe-QD-C.xyz
C. CdSe-QD-A.xyz
D. CdSe-QD-B.xyz

附件：CdSe-QD-A.xyz、CdSe-QD-B.xyz、CdSe-QD-C.xyz、CdSe-QD-D.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文经验曲线出题；纳米晶为本项目构建的模型（理想闪锌矿球形切割，a = 6.08 Å，无配体），不是实测结构。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
